title: Church of God in Christ singing and joyful noise
summary: Asked about Church of God in Christ, the man says they sing the same hymns too fast with tambourines and guitar.

story.theme_name: Church, faith and religion in a musician's life
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular

blocks.x: In fact, we call that the Methodist Church. Yeah. Well, what about the Church of God and Christ? How do they sing? Do y'all know? I don't know.

Well, they really do believe they go away with it. They sing the same hymn but I can't catch them. They go too fast for me. They pat their foots and pat their hands and shout and go. Tambourines and guitar and everything.
Don't mind making a joyful noise, then, eh?
I can't catch them. Yes, indeed. Well, I see most of the rest of them but not them. They sound like that.
What's that 110, huh? What, uh? Make a joyful noise, huh? 110, I think.
